name: destructive-action
sequence: User initiates the destructive action from a button with variant=destructive
AlertDialog opens, focus trapped, naming the specific object and the specific consequence
AlertDialogAction carries the destructive variant and a verb-specific label — Delete project, not OK
AlertDialogCancel is present, is the default focus target, and Escape dismisses
On confirm, a Toast reports the outcome and offers undo when the operation is reversible
requiredRules: Name the object being destroyed in the dialog body
Label the confirm button with the verb, never OK or Yes
Support full keyboard operation and Escape dismissal
forbiddenRules: No tooltip or popover as the only warning surface
No destructive variant on a non-destructive action
No AI agent triggering this flow without an explicit human gesture
codeSketch:
<AlertDialog>
  <AlertDialogTrigger asChild><Button variant="destructive">Delete project</Button></AlertDialogTrigger>
  <AlertDialogContent>
    <AlertDialogHeader>
      <AlertDialogTitle>Delete “Apollo”?</AlertDialogTitle>
      <AlertDialogDescription>This removes the project and its 42 runs. This cannot be undone.</AlertDialogDescription>
    </AlertDialogHeader>
    <AlertDialogFooter>
      <AlertDialogCancel>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel>
      <AlertDialogAction className="bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground">Delete project</AlertDialogAction>
    </AlertDialogFooter>
  </AlertDialogContent>
</AlertDialog>
